source: main-agent live Playwright walk (admin role, :8000) — 29 pages auto-enumerated from sidebar nav

live_findings.title: OSS (customer-facing 'Suivi client') shows admin header chrome until fullscreen
live_findings.evidence: The customer-facing order-status screen renders the admin top bar (branch selector, 'Tableau De Bord' link, and 'Bonjour Admin Le Cayenne' with the operator's name) by default; a green fullscreen toggle exists but is opt-in.
live_findings.why_it_matters: A screen meant for customers in the dining area exposes the operator's name + admin navigation until someone manually presses fullscreen. Minor privacy/professionalism issue on a public display.

live_findings.title: KDS order timer shows raw minutes for old orders (e.g. '926:5x') with no hour formatting
live_findings.evidence: On the KDS, stale orders show timers like '926:5' (=15h+); the format is MM:SS and does not roll over to hours, so very old tickets read as a large minute count.
live_findings.why_it_matters: Only visible under stale/test data, but the timer format does not gracefully handle >60min; a chef glancing at '926:5' gets no useful elapsed signal.

live_findings.title: KDS caps the visible list (49 shown, '+41 en attente / Liste pleine') and asks the chef to filter
live_findings.evidence: KDS banner: 'Liste pleine (49 affichee(s), max. serveur) : d'autres commandes actives existent peut-etre - filtrez par statut ou cherchez un n de ticket.' with a red '+41 en attente' badge.
live_findings.why_it_matters: Honest degradation, but under a genuine rush a hidden active order beyond the cap is a missed-order risk; the cap + filter is the only mitigation. (Mostly an artefact of the test-data backlog here.)

live_findings.title: KDS shows 49 active orders vs OSS shows 1 'En preparation' — verify the filter difference is intentional (live vs stale backlog), not a sync gap
live_findings.file_line: KDS vs OSS list queries (kitchenDisplaySystem vs orderStatusScreen controllers)
live_findings.evidence: Same instant: KDS displays 49 active cards (+41 queued) while OSS 'En preparation' shows only N A0053 and 'Pret' is empty.
live_findings.why_it_matters: If OSS and KDS draw from different status/time filters this is expected (OSS=today's live queue, KDS=all active incl. 15h-old test orders); if it is a sync/filter bug, customers would not see orders that are actually cooking. Needs confirmation.
